source.original_title: 05/18/2026 - Galal Beshir & Harry Edmonds KFS- Kettlebell Body Game Plan Session
source.display_title: 05/18/2026 - Galal Beshir & Harry Edmonds KFS- Kettlebell Body Game Plan Session — Undetermined

setter.name: Kim Forbes-Sobers
setter.evidence: Rep: 'I know you spoke with Kim. He gave me like an overview as well. So I've kind of got a little bit of a head start.' Prospect independently: 'as I was telling um i was telling uh kim earlier i was just uh looking to you know better my uh health'.

prospect.name: Galal Beshir
prospect.occupation: Working and also studying — referenced needing to arrange recommendation letters. Employer and field not stated.
prospect.family_status: Has nephews he describes as being like his sons and wants to be a role model for. Trains at the gym with his brother.
prospect.training_background: Lost roughly 60 lb over the past year, from 260 lb down to around 200, currently fluctuating between 199 and 205. Runs, with weekly mileage swinging from 18 miles in a strong week down to three in a weak one. Has done conventional strength training in the past and found it cost him mobility and flexibility. Trains at multiple gyms. Tried a kettlebell circuit from Trevor's Instagram reels once the week before the call — started at 35 lb, put it down, moved to 20 lb, and completed four of six prescribed rounds of thrusters, double squats, push-ups and cleans.

signals: Proposed label: the_self_made_improver. He has already delivered a major unaided transformation — 60 lb down from 260 — and is buying structure to consolidate and extend it, not to start.

Not the_rebuilder: he is not seeking a former self, he is shedding one. 'in every, like, workout or every exercise... it's just me becoming, shedding off the old me, you know, coming in some, like, somewhere new.'
Not the_optimizer: he self-rates at six out of ten, is not established as affluent, and hesitated at the number when it landed.
Diagnoses his own gap precisely and it maps exactly onto the product: 'I have the motivation but I think it's just the routine and the direction.'
Motivation is legacy-shaped rather than appearance-shaped — credibility to guide his nephews is the stated end state

goals.text: Build a healthy lifestyle with a real routine rather than deciding day to day
Be a role model to his nephews and show them improvement is possible at any starting point
Earn the confidence and credibility to guide other people
Longevity — keep being able to do this over the long term
Settle at a stable weight instead of teetering between 199 and 205
Have the energy to provide and to do his duties
Get mobility, cardio and strength from one form of training
Feel after every session the way he felt after his first kettlebell circuit

pains.text: No planned routine — trains and eats reactively, 'shooting from the hip'
Oscillates between very strict and very lenient with food and never finds the middle
Cannot stay in the zone and does not know why: 'I'm having trouble finding that, you know, staying in that zone. And I can't find the reason why'
External stress and people crashing his mood takes its toll and derails him
Weight fluctuating either side of 200 lb because of cravings
Training volume swings wildly week to week — 18 miles one week, three the next
Past strength training cost him mobility and flexibility, leaving him 'this one big bulk of meat'

Has no direction and nobody further along to follow: 'I could talk to a lot of people that are maybe like eights and nines and sevens... but they can only take you so far because they've never been to a 10'

objections.raw_quote: Okay. Yeah. I'd have to see because 6K, yeah. Yeah.
objections.rep_response: Not observable. The recording ends approximately twenty-six seconds later, mid-turn, with the rep saying 'Payment dipped on me, crazy.' Nothing in the transcript establishes how or whether the objection was handled.

objections.raw_quote: And is this six, is it like one flat rate at one time, or is it like a process of through, like, bi-weekly or is it weekly?
objections.rep_response: Answered with the standard framing rather than a plan: 'Most people just put it on a credit card and just pay it off in the meantime. That's what most people do.' No instalment structure was offered before the recording ended.

offer.guarantee_mentioned: 'we guarantee you that by the end of the six months with the core three lifts of kettlebells, you will be using an eight kilo heavier kettlebell in six months time with the same rep, same intensity, same everything.' Illustrated as 'let's say you're swinging around a 20 now... In six months, you will be swinging around double the weight that you're doing now.'

evidence: The recording terminates at 00:35:00, mid-conversation, roughly twenty-six seconds after the price objection first surfaced. There is no decision on the transcript in either direction
Last substantive prospect turn is a hesitation, not a refusal and not an agreement: 'I'd have to see because 6K, yeah'

Everything before the cut points warm: 'it seems like the perfect fit', 'I don't think anything's missing', an unqualified yes to both commitment questions, and an active preference expressed between tiers ('I think lean towards more of the 6K')
Against that, the payment-structure question immediately preceding the cut suggests the lump sum was a live problem and no plan had yet been offered
Marked undetermined rather than follow_up because asserting a next step would be inventing one. The call did not end here; the recording did
outcome.next_step: Unknown — the recording ends before any next step was established. Prior to the cut the rep had described booking the Trevor onboarding call for the following day or Wednesday, with tailored plans 24-48 hours after.

notable.note: The outcome of this call is unrecoverable from the file: the recording stops mid-turn at the exact moment the money conversation began. If it is being counted anywhere as a loss or a follow-up, that is an assumption rather than a record. On process, this is the strongest discovery in the batch alongside the Gallegos call — the goals work is close to complete, the reflect-back landed ('sounds like this is a lot more than just swinging some kettlebells around for you... It sounds like it's more about who you can become'), and the rep used an unscripted ten-out-of-ten scaling question that produced the prospect naming the product's exact value proposition back to him: 'I have the motivation but I think it's just the routine and the direction.' Conduct was clean throughout. When the prospect misremembered the twelve-month tier as $12K, the rep corrected him downward to $9K unprompted — the opposite of the pattern seen elsewhere in this folder. The one systematic gap recurs: no consequence frame, for the sixth consecutive call.

quality.notes: Two distinct problems. First, connection instability: the prospect's phone died around 00:00:51 and there is a two-minute gap before he rejoins on a computer at 00:02:55, with further mid-call dropouts at 00:10:59 and 00:30:56. His label also changes from 'Galal' to 'Galal Beshir' at the rejoin. Second, heavy inversion — the entire offer walkthrough from 00:21:36 to 00:29:23 alternates wrongly, with the rep's pillar and support descriptions repeatedly landing under the prospect's label, and the exchange at 00:11:30 to 00:11:34 has the question and its echo attributed to the wrong speakers. Roles read from content throughout.
